headline: You're gaining weight—eat discipline, move intentionally starting now
summary: Today you must replace emotional eating with intentional fueling and exercise to close the 0.8kg weekly gap you're currently missing.
details: Eat only portioned Huel meals today—no snacking, no exceptions—to stop the pattern that's added 1.8kg this month instead of losing weight. Do 40 minutes on the rowing machine or treadmill today to create a real deficit and build momentum. This week matters: you're gaining instead of losing, and with 287 days until your 88kg target, every single day of discipline now compounds into the outcome you want.
